trans-unit.source: This 4D application allows you to perform semantic search on a set of icons (the Material Design icons by Google, available at https://fonts.google.com/icons). An OpenAI key will be needed in order to transform the text prompt into a vector. An ORDA query will then retrieve the best vector matches and display a list of icons ranked by similarity to the search prompt.
